stem.text: A steel bar of circular cross-section is under tension $T$, as shown.

stem.alt: Steel bar of circular cross-section with a wide portion on the left and a narrower portion on the right, with tension arrows labelled T at both ends.

stem.text: The diameter of the wide portion is double the diameter of the narrow portion.
What is the value of $\dfrac{\text{stress in the wide portion}}{\text{stress in the narrow portion}}$?
